name: n1_r3b
move: N1 Kyrie (m1_1), MOVESET.md section 1: 10 drawings, 33 f at 60 fps. Round 3b (r3 critics): slow-in A1 25% / A2 the coil / A3 a 2 px sink; C1 = the high-in-front end of the scoop; F1 and F2 continue that arc over her head; R1-R3 a progressive settle into idle; a thick J smear with the glaive drawn bent (smear v2); world-pinned stole lag.

hero._about: Round 3b. blend = an absolute mix of other keys' states; glaive = the weapon in world; sink = the hips lowered (m) with the feet planted; wL = the left hand's grip weight at that key.

A1 drop._why: r3 critics: f0 -> f1 jumped into a near-coil, so the slow-in was invisible. A1 is now 20% of the way (a weight drop), the glaive only tipping back from upright

A2 coil._why: the bulk of the wind-up in one drawing

A3 coil._why: a 1 px sink into the held coil (1 px = 1.3 cm at 144 px), cloth still settling

C1 contact._why: r3 critics: C1 is the high-in-front end of the scoop, not a horizontal chest thrust

F1 carry._why: the arc continues from high-in-front over her head (no pop to vertical)

R1 settle._why: r3 critics: R1-R3 were near-identical holds, then a pop into idle at f28

plants._why: A1 is a weight drop: the feet stay on the idle spots until the coil (A2)

cloth_lag._why: DESIGN.md 8: stole tails trail 2-3 drawings; 4 f = 2 drawings of delay on the drape

cloth_world._why: r3 critics: the stole lag measured 1-2 f on screen because the root rides the body. 60% of the spring target is where the lagged drape hung in space, so the tails stay behind on screen while she moves, then swing through

cloth_dyn._why: zeta 0.3: one visible overshoot after the swing-through, then settle; N1 (r3 critics: its cloth on holds moved less than round 2's, 1.1k vs 1.6k px): hair, sleeves and tabard a little underdamped (zeta 0.26-0.28) so they swing on

smear._about: smear_v2.py (tools/motion-ai): band, profile, colour, bent glaive, 4x raster; see its docstring

S1._why: MOVESET N1 S1 / r3 critics: one J-crescent from a knife-thin tail on the floor behind her, a belly along the floor under her feet, rising into a thick curved head high in front; the glaive itself drawn bent (ref 09), the solid one hidden on this drawing
